acceptance_rule: Gate 1 must reuse the active post-MTM frozen-input identity. Gate 2 requires entry_date/target_price plus real daily cash and active-core-position fields. Gate 3 core survival must remain at least 5%. Accept only if aggregate EV improves by more than 10%, aggregate PnL is positive, at least two windows improve with no window EV or PnL regression, max-drawdown worsening is at most 0.5 percentage points, overlay uses no leverage and never displaces a core entry, and concentration remains within 50% single ticker and 0.35 HHI. Otherwise reject and leave default behavior off.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.
